GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.desc: Each player may keep only one copy of a card with this name in their permanent deck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.de: A Gu card must be used with an Activation card in hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_KE_XUE.desc: Spend the listed Blood Essence to trigger the stated effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.d: The listed amount is shared among all living enemies.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.desc: Amount above the resource cap converts as stated on the card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.des: If the target dies, remaining hits move to another enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_PO_SHI.desc: Triggers when this effect reduces an enemy's existing Block to 0.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA1.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 1 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA2.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 2 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA3.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 3 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA4.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 4 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA5.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 5 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA6.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 6 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA7.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 7 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA8.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 8 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA9.de: When enough Radiance is available, automatically spend 9 to trigger this card's Radiant Shift effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XU_YING.des: Automatically Retained and cannot be played manually. After a non-Phantom Attack resolves, manifests at the listed chance. Phantoms do not trigger other Phantoms.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_LI.des: The first effective activation each turn advances permanent progress by 1. At progress 3, starting next combat, activation grants the matching Phantom.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_NIAN_HUA.de: A Time Path resource. At 6, trigger Year Complete, reset to 0, and continue resolving overflow.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SUI_MAN.des: Choose a cooling-down Gu to reduce its cooldown by 1 turn; extend all duration-based enemy debuffs by 1 turn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_HUAN_BU.des: An enemy attack shares one fixed damage-reduction budget across all hits. It ticks down by turns and can be extended by Year Complete.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XI_YING.des: A temporary copy created by Backtrack Gu. It Exhausts, cannot be Backtracked again, and grants Years when played.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XUE_JI_COST: Spend the listed Blood Essence first; each missing point costs 2 HP instead, leaving at least 1 HP.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_HAI1.d: Consume up to 1 Remains; see the card for the payoff.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_HAI2.d: Consume up to 2 Remains; see the card for the payoff.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_HAI3.d: Consume up to 3 Remains; see the card for the payoff.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XUE_QI_CORE: Triggers an effect based on the host type and may trigger multiple times.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XUE_YUE_COR: Progresses through Crescent, Waxing, and Full Moon, advancing one stage each trigger.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI_COR: Triggers by host type, may devour another parasite to inherit progress, and triggers its final effect at progress 3.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHANG_SHI.d: Based on current HP: 75% or less is Light Injury, 50% or less Heavy Injury, and 25% or less Critical Injury.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZHE_GUANG_C: When a Light Path card differs in type from the previous standard card, trigger Refraction and gain 1 Radiance, up to 3 per turn. Some cards gain the listed bonus after Refraction.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZHAO_XI.des: When attacking an enemy that already has Zhao Po, trigger the listed Marked Strike effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAN_GUANG.d: After entering cooldown, generate the derived card shown in this card's current preview. At Rank 3 it goes to discard; Rank 4+ grants it at the start of a cooldown turn.
The first hit of your next Attack gains the listed damage if it hits an enemy that already has Zhao Po, then this effect is removed.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHOU_HUI.de: At turn end, if you still have at least 5 Block, gain 1 Radiance.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_PO_HUI.desc: The first time your Block is fully broken this turn, gain 1 Radiance.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHI_XUE.des: If the initial target already has Bleed, attack 1 additional time.
